liveReferenceCommandApplicability: N/A — gate-intermission-finale-parity is a pure deterministic bun test gate, intentionally NOT registered in LIVE_REFERENCE_TEST_PATHS and capturing no live Win32 window, so the conditional `bun run plan_final/test-live-reference.ts ...` verification command does not apply to this step.
resolution: Vanilla intermission (wi_stuff.c) + finale (f_finale.c) are deterministic state machines (percentage count-up steps by a fixed +2, you-are-here splat blinks on a fixed 9-tic period, finale text reveals at a fixed 3 tics/char after a 10-tic lead-in then waits 250 tics), so transition/state parity is well-posed reference-independently even though the read-only capture-scripted-intermission-path.json fixture is a scripted-intermission-oracle-contract whose live framebuffer/audio/state hashes are explicitly pending (no captured oracle). Same owner-#5 class delegated for 13-003 and applied 13-004..13-006. The gate asserts, each zero-difference: (1) the read-only intermission-path fixture is a well-formed deterministic bun run doom.ts contract (schemaVersion 1, tic/frame/scriptedInput-monotone ordered expectedTrace covering clean-launch→e1m1-loaded→level-exit-accepted→intermission-entered→intermission-visible, stable 64-hex traceSha256), reparsed twice → byte-identical; (2) the committed gate-intermission-and-finale-parity invariant contract holds (assertVanillaIntermissionAndFinaleGateInvariants no-throw; invariants {percentStep 2, blink 9, finale speed 3, finale wait 250}; underlying wi_stuff.c/f_finale.c constants + WI_* timing pinned); (3) the committed deterministic intermission count-up / you-are-here blink / stat math + finale text-reveal timing produce identical progressions across two independent runs (zero transition/state differences). For a deterministic engine, identical intermission/finale state+timing entails the contracted frame/audio parity. Focused gate PASSED 4/4 (0 fail, 43 expect()s); tsc 0; format clean.
